name: event_ticketing
description: Simplified create_booking by removing the try/except that converted sqlite3.Error into a clean error dict and stripping the ok/error wrapper from the failure paths, relying on callers to handle DB failures. main.py handlers were lightly refactored but keep using the documented ok/error contract.
flaw: create_booking in db.py no longer catches sqlite3.Error and its error paths now return {"error": {...}} without the "ok" key, breaking the documented ok/error dict contract. All three callers in main.py (handle_book_ticket, handle_bulk_booking, handle_guest_booking) still assume the contract: a failure path now raises KeyError on result["ok"], and any DB failure escapes as an unhandled sqlite3.Error, crashing the request path.
